title: Outcomes of Efforts to Preserve Orderliness in and around Waterloo Mall Given Illegal Hawking
what_it_is: Outcomes of Efforts to Preserve Orderliness in and around Waterloo Mall Given Illegal Hawking

sections.label: Street vendor licensing and enforcement
sections.summary: SLA issued Temporary Occupation Licences to street vendors to trade in designated spaces, and agencies conduct joint operations to enforce licensing conditions and maintain order.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The objective was to improve public health and safety, as well as to enhance the streetscape.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: As part of this exercise, SLA issued Temporary Occupation Licences (TOLs) to existing street vendors to enable and require that they ply their trades within designated spaces.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: To preserve orderliness, agencies regularly conduct joint operations, especially during peak periods, to enforce licensing conditions and maintain order in the area.

sections.label: Support for vulnerable persons and enforcement
sections.summary: Agencies refer vulnerable persons to the Vulnerable-In-Community Network, and SPF supports joint operations near Waterloo Street temples with a balanced enforcement approach.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: For those who may be vulnerable, agencies work with the Ministry of Social and Family Development to refer them to the Vulnerable-In-Community Network, comprising volunteer groups and Government agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Those requiring assistance will be linked to relevant agencies, so that the root causes can be addressed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: These joint operations are supported by the Singapore Police Force (SPF), which maintains a balanced enforcement approach in the vicinity of the temples along Waterloo Street, that considers both community sensitivities and public safety needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The regular presence of Government agencies has generally helped in maintaining order among the unlicensed street hawkers and other groups, and minimised incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Law (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The agencies will continue to monitor the situation closely.
